Hi Logan / Monica,

Thanks for taking this on. BrightShore is completing our SIG/CAIQ submission and the assessor flagged contractor screening as an open item. We need the following by EOD Pacific (we know it's tight):

- Summary of tiered contractor screening policy (what checks for contractors vs full-time)
- Sample redacted background check PDF (contractor cohort, 3 records)
- High-level chain-of-custody statement for how we receive/store screening reports

Two quick asks on redaction: please include the redaction approach you use for SSNs (last-4 vs full mask) and whether date-of-birth is preserved as year-only or removed. Our assessor prefers maximal minimization but needs to see the exact method.

If you can drop a checklist or bundle link I can share with the assessor directly.

Amelia — thanks for the clear asks. Quick plan and what I'm attaching:

1) Tiered policy summary (attached as contractor-vetting-matrix.csv) — shows minimal vs enhanced checks and required evidence per contractor role.
2) Redaction standard: we permanently remove SSNs except we retain a last-4 token in our HR system only; for artifacts we produce for customers/assessors we mask to "XXX-XX-1234" (example) and truncate DOB to year only (e.g., 1986). Details are in redaction-guidelines-PII-v2.pdf attached.
3) Sample artifacts: I'll include 3 redacted contractor BG PDFs in the Drive folder (link below). They are redacted per the attached guidelines and have a short redaction log appended to each PDF (date, redacted fields).
4) Chain-of-custody: brief paragraph included in the Drive README.

Attachments: redaction-guidelines-PII-v2.pdf, contractor-vetting-matrix.csv.
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_evidence-folder
HubSpot: HS-12345

If this meets the assessor's needs, Monica and I can produce a DocuSign attestation for the three deliverables — I added Karthik to confirm procurement/legal sign-off for the attestation.

— Logan
